title.sk: Thajské červené kari s kuracím mäsom

description.sk: Voňavé kokosové kari s limetkou a zeleninou.
description.en: A fragrant coconut curry with lime and vegetables.

steps.sk: Uvar ryžu podľa návodu.
steps.en: Cook the rice according to the packet.

steps.sk: Na oleji minútu opekaj kari pastu, kým nezavonia. Prilej tretinu kokosového mlieka a var 2 minúty.
steps.en: Fry the curry paste in the oil for a minute until fragrant. Add a third of the coconut milk and simmer for 2 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso nakrájané na tenké plátky a opekaj 3 minúty.
steps.en: Add the thinly sliced chicken and cook for 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Prilej zvyšné kokosové mlieko a 100 ml vody, pridaj papriku a cuketu a var 8 minút, kým nie je mäso vnútri biele a zelenina ešte jemne chrumkavá.
steps.en: Add the remaining coconut milk and 100 ml water, the pepper and zucchini and simmer for 8 minutes, until the chicken is white throughout and the vegetables are still slightly crisp.

steps.sk: Dochuť rybacou omáčkou, cukrom a limetkovou šťavou, posyp bazalkou a podávaj s ryžou.
steps.en: Season with fish sauce, sugar and lime juice, sprinkle with basil and serve with the rice.

description.sk: Ryžové rezance s vajíčkom, klíčkami a arašidmi v sladkokyslej omáčke.
description.en: Rice noodles with egg, bean sprouts and peanuts in a sweet-sour sauce.

steps.sk: Rezance namoč na 10 minút do horúcej vody a sceď.
steps.en: Soak the noodles in hot water for 10 minutes and drain.

steps.sk: Omáčka: zmiešaj rybaciu a sójovú omáčku, cukor, ocot a polovicu limetkovej šťavy.
steps.en: Sauce: mix the fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, vinegar and half the lime juice.

steps.sk: Na rozpálenom oleji opekaj mäso nakrájané na prúžky s cesnakom 5 minút, kým nie je biele a prepečené.
steps.en: Stir-fry the chicken strips with the garlic in the hot oil for 5 minutes until white and cooked through.

steps.sk: Mäso posuň na okraj, do stredu rozbi vajcia a zamiešaj ich. Pridaj rezance a omáčku a premiešavaj 2 minúty.
steps.en: Push the chicken to one side, crack the eggs into the middle and scramble them. Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 minutes.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj klíčky a cibuľku a podávaj posypané nasekanými arašidmi, čili a zvyšnou limetkovou šťavou.
steps.en: Stir in the bean sprouts and spring onion and serve topped with chopped peanuts, chili and the remaining lime juice.

description.sk: Ľahké závitky z ryžového papiera s bylinkami a arašidovou omáčkou.
description.en: Light rice-paper rolls with herbs and a peanut dipping sauce.

steps.sk: Krevety var vo vode 2 až 3 minúty, kým nie sú ružové a nepriehľadné. Schlaď ich a pozdĺžne rozpoľ.
steps.en: Simmer the shrimp for 2–3 minutes until pink and opaque. Cool them and halve lengthwise.

steps.sk: Rezance zalej vriacou vodou na 5 minút, sceď a prepláchni studenou vodou. Uhorku a mrkvu nakrájaj na tenké prúžky.
steps.en: Pour boiling water over the noodles for 5 minutes, drain and rinse in cold water. Cut the cucumber and carrot into thin strips.

steps.sk: List ryžového papiera ponor na 10 sekúnd do vlažnej vody a polož ho na vlhkú dosku.
steps.en: Dip a sheet of rice paper in lukewarm water for 10 seconds and lay it on a damp board.

steps.sk: Do stredu daj šalát, rezance, zeleninu a bylinky a navrch krevety. Zahni boky a pevne zaroluj. Opakuj so zvyšnými listami.
steps.en: Place lettuce, noodles, vegetables and herbs in the centre with shrimp on top. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Repeat with the remaining sheets.

steps.sk: Omáčka: rozmiešaj arašidové maslo s hoisin omáčkou, limetkovou šťavou a 3 lyžicami teplej vody.
steps.en: Sauce: whisk the peanut butter with the hoisin sauce, lime juice and 3 tablespoons of warm water.

description.sk: Aromatický vývar s badiánom a škoricou, tenké plátky hovädzieho a ryžové rezance.
description.en: An aromatic broth with star anise and cinnamon, thin slices of beef and rice noodles.

steps.sk: Cibuľu rozpoľ a zázvor nakrájaj na plátky. Na suchej panvici ich opeč reznou stranou nadol dočierna, asi 5 minút.
steps.en: Halve the onion and slice the ginger. Char them cut side down in a dry pan until blackened, about 5 minutes.

steps.sk: V hrnci nasucho opraž badián, škoricu a klinčeky, kým nezavoňajú. Pridaj cibuľu, zázvor, bujóny a 1,8 l vody a mierne var 25 minút.
steps.en: Toast the star anise, cinnamon and cloves in a dry pot until fragrant. Add the onion, ginger, stock cubes and 1.8 l water and simmer gently for 25 minutes.

steps.sk: Mäso daj na 15 minút do mrazničky a potom ho nakrájaj na čo najtenšie plátky.
steps.en: Put the beef in the freezer for 15 minutes, then slice it as thinly as possible.

steps.sk: Rezance priprav podľa návodu a rozdeľ do misiek. Vývar preceď, dochuť rybacou omáčkou a cukrom a priveď do varu.
steps.en: Prepare the noodles according to the packet and divide between bowls. Strain the broth, season with fish sauce and sugar and bring it back to the boil.

steps.sk: Na rezance poukladaj surové plátky mäsa a zalej ich vriacim vývarom – mäso sa v ňom za minútu uvarí doružova. Ak ho chceš prepečené, povar plátky vo vývare 1 minútu.
steps.en: Arrange the raw beef slices on the noodles and ladle the boiling broth over them; the beef cooks to pink within a minute. For well-done beef, simmer the slices in the broth for 1 minute first.

steps.sk: Podávaj s klíčkami, cibuľkou, bylinkami, čili a mesiačikmi limetky.
steps.en: Serve with bean sprouts, spring onion, herbs, chili and lime wedges.

title.sk: Tom kha kai – kokosová polievka s kuracím
title.en: Tom kha kai: coconut chicken soup

description.sk: Krémová, kyslastá a voňavá thajská polievka.
description.en: A creamy, tangy and fragrant Thai soup.

steps.sk: Zázvor nakrájaj na plátky a var ho s bujónom v 600 ml vody 5 minút.
steps.en: Slice the ginger and simmer it with the stock cube in 600 ml water for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj kokosové mlieko, nakrájané huby a mäso nakrájané na tenké plátky a mierne var 8 minút, kým mäso nie je vnútri biele.
steps.en: Add the coconut milk, sliced mushrooms and thinly sliced chicken and simmer gently for 8 minutes until the chicken is white throughout.

steps.sk: Odstav, dochuť rybacou omáčkou, limetkovou šťavou a cukrom a pridaj nakrájané čili.
steps.en: Take off the heat, season with fish sauce, lime juice and sugar and add the sliced chili.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypané koriandrom. Plátky zázvoru sa nejedia.
steps.en: Serve sprinkled with coriander. The ginger slices are not eaten.

description.sk: Bún thịt nướng po domácky: karamelizované bravčové, rezance a veľa zeleniny.
description.en: Homestyle bún thịt nướng: caramelised pork, noodles and lots of vegetables.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na tenké plátky a marinuj 15 minút v 2 lyžiciach rybacej omáčky, lyžici cukru a 2 strúčikoch cesnaku.
steps.en: Slice the pork thinly and marinate for 15 minutes in 2 tablespoons of fish sauce, a tablespoon of sugar and 2 garlic cloves.

steps.sk: Dresing: zmiešaj zvyšnú rybaciu omáčku a cukor, limetkovú šťavu, zvyšný cesnak, čili a 4 lyžice vody.
steps.en: Dressing: mix the remaining fish sauce and sugar, the lime juice, remaining garlic, chili and 4 tablespoons of water.

steps.sk: Rezance priprav podľa návodu a prepláchni studenou vodou. Zeleninu nakrájaj na prúžky.
steps.en: Prepare the noodles according to the packet and rinse in cold water. Cut the vegetables into strips.

steps.sk: Mäso opekaj na rozpálenom oleji 5 až 6 minút, kým nie je skaramelizované a prepečené.
steps.en: Fry the pork in hot oil for 5–6 minutes until caramelised and cooked through.

steps.sk: Do misiek daj rezance, zeleninu, bylinky a mäso, posyp arašidmi a polej dresingom.
steps.en: Fill bowls with noodles, vegetables, herbs and pork, sprinkle with peanuts and pour over the dressing.

title.sk: Larb – thajský šalát z mletého morčacieho

description.sk: Ľahký a svieži šalát s limetkou, bylinkami a pražnou ryžou, podávaný v listoch šalátu.
description.en: A light, zesty salad with lime, herbs and toasted rice, served in lettuce cups.

steps.sk: Ryžu opraž na suchej panvici dozlatista a rozdrv ju v mažiari alebo valčekom.
steps.en: Toast the rice in a dry pan until golden and crush it with a pestle or rolling pin.

steps.sk: Mäso daj na panvicu s 3 lyžicami vody a za stáleho rozbíjania ho var 6 až 7 minút, kým nie je úplne bez ružovej farby.
steps.en: Put the turkey in a pan with 3 tablespoons of water and cook, breaking it up, for 6–7 minutes until no pink remains.

steps.sk: Odstav a vmiešaj rybaciu omáčku, limetkovú šťavu, cukor, čili, cibuľu a bylinky.
steps.en: Take off the heat and stir in the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, chili, onions and herbs.

steps.sk: Posyp pražnou ryžou a podávaj v listoch šalátu.
steps.en: Sprinkle with the toasted rice and serve in lettuce leaves.

title.sk: Thajské tofu s kešu orechmi a zeleninou

description.sk: Rýchle restovanie s chrumkavými orechmi, limetkou a čili.
description.en: A quick stir-fry with crunchy nuts, lime and chili.

steps.sk: Uvar ryžu. Tofu osuš, nakrájaj na kocky a opeč na polovici oleja dozlatista. Odlož ho.
steps.en: Cook the rice. Pat the tofu dry, cube it and fry in half the oil until golden. Set aside.

steps.sk: Kešu opraž na suchej panvici, kým nezhnednú.
steps.en: Toast the cashews in a dry pan until browned.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji opekaj cibuľu, papriku a brokolicu s cesnakom 4 minúty.
steps.en: Stir-fry the onion, pepper and broccoli with the garlic in the remaining oil for 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Zmiešaj sójovú omáčku, cukor, limetkovú šťavu, čili, škrob a 4 lyžice vody, vlej do panvice, pridaj tofu a kešu a premiešaj, kým omáčka nezhustne.
steps.en: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, lime juice, chili, starch and 4 tablespoons of water, pour into the pan, add the tofu and cashews and toss until the sauce thickens.

steps.sk: Podávaj s ryžou.
steps.en: Serve with the rice.

description.sk: Vietnamská bageta s rýchlo nakladanou zeleninou, koriandrom a pikantnou majonézou.
description.en: A Vietnamese baguette with quick-pickled vegetables, coriander and spicy mayo.

steps.sk: Mrkvu nakrájaj na tenké prúžky a zalej octom s cukrom a štipkou soli. Nechaj 15 minút nakladať.
steps.en: Cut the carrot into matchsticks and cover with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt. Pickle for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na tenké plátky, premiešaj so sójovou omáčkou a cesnakom a na oleji opekaj 5 až 6 minút, kým nie je prepečené.
steps.en: Slice the chicken thinly, toss with the soy sauce and garlic and fry in the oil for 5–6 minutes until cooked through.

steps.sk: Majonézu zmiešaj s čili omáčkou.
steps.en: Mix the mayonnaise with the chili sauce.

steps.sk: Bagetky rozkroj, natri majonézou a naplň mäsom, nakladanou mrkvou, plátkami uhorky a koriandrom.
steps.en: Split the rolls, spread with the mayo and fill with the chicken, pickled carrot, cucumber slices and coriander.

description.sk: Losos dusený v karamelovej omáčke s rybacou omáčkou a korením – cá kho.
description.en: Salmon braised in a caramel and fish sauce glaze with pepper: cá kho.

steps.sk: Uvar ryžu. Lososa nakrájaj na väčšie kocky.
steps.en: Cook the rice. Cut the salmon into large cubes.

steps.sk: Na panvici roztop cukor s olejom a var na strednom ohni, kým nezmení farbu na jantárovú. Pozor, aby nezhorkol.
steps.en: Melt the sugar with the oil in a pan and cook over medium heat until amber. Take care not to let it burn.

steps.sk: Opatrne prilej rybaciu omáčku a 100 ml vody, pridaj cesnak a priveď do varu.
steps.en: Carefully add the fish sauce and 100 ml water, add the garlic and bring to the boil.

steps.sk: Vlož lososa a var 8 minút, občas ho polej omáčkou, kým sa nezmení na lesklú glazúru a losos sa ľahko rozpadáva.
steps.en: Add the salmon and simmer for 8 minutes, basting now and then, until the sauce turns glossy and the salmon flakes easily.

steps.sk: Posyp korením, cibuľkou a čili a podávaj s ryžou a uhorkou.
steps.en: Sprinkle with pepper, spring onion and chili and serve with the rice and cucumber.
